s.d: άντι-χριατος, -ον, ό Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): [[1-john 2 18|1Jn.2:18]] [[john 2 22|Jn 2:22]] [[john 4 3|Jn 4:3]], [[1-john 1 7|1Jn.1:7]] pl. [[1-john 2 18|1Jn.2:18]] (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀντλέω, -ῶ (ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;] 1. prop., to bale out. 2. Generally, to draw water: absol., [[john 2 8|Jhn.2:8 4:15]]; ὕδωρ, [[john 2 9|Jhn.2:9 4:7]] (on its use of the water made wine, see DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, see word; Field, Notes, 84 f.).† (AS)
ἄντλημα, -τος, τό (ἀντλέω), (a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.); (b) a vessel to draw with, a bucket (Plut.; see Abbott, Essays, 88): [[john 4 11|Jhn.4:11.]]† (AS)

ἀντοφθαλμέω, -ῶ (ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wis.12:14 * ;] to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaphorical, to face, withstand (Wis, l.with, Polyb.): with dative, ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, to beat up against the wind (see DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, see word): [[acts 27 15|Act.27:15.]]† (AS)

ἄνυδρος, -ον (ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ), etc. ;] waterless: τόποι, [[matthew 12 43|Mat.12:43]], [[luke 11 24|Luk.11:24]]; πηγαί, [[2-peter 2 17|2Pe.2:17;]] νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀν-υπόκριτος, -ον (ά- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι) [in LXX: Wis.5:18 18:16 * ;] unfeigned: [[romans 12 9|Rom.12:9]], [[2-corinthians 6 6|2Co.6:6]], [[1-timothy 1 5|1Ti.1:5]], [[2-timothy 1 5|2Ti.1:5]], [[james 3 17|Jas.3:17]], [[1-peter 1 22|1Pe.1:22]] (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀνυπότακτος, -ον (ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: [[1-kings 2 12|1Ki.2:12 10:27]] (for LXX, λοιμός, בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;] of things, not subject to rule: [[hebrews 2 8|Heb.2:8;]] of persons, unruly: [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]], [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6, 10]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἄνω adv (ἀνά), (a) up, upwards: [[john 11 41|Jhn.11:41]], [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15]]; (b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, [[galatians 4 26|Gal.4:26]], [[philippians 3 14|Php.3:14]]; τά, [[john 8 23|Jhn.8:23]], [[colossians 3 1|Col.3:1-2]]; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), [[john 2 7|Jhn.2:7]] (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, see word), -ου, τό (ἀνά, γῆ), an upper room: [[mark 14 15|Mrk.14:15]], [[luke 22 12|Luk.22:12]].† SYN.: ὑπερῷον (AS)

ἄνωθεν adv (ἄνω), (a) from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., [[matthew 27 51|Mat.27:51]], [[mark 15 38|Mrk.15:38]]; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., [[john 19 28|Jhn.19:28;]] meaning, from heaven: [[john 3 31|Jhn.3:31 19:11]], [[james 1 17|Jas.1:17 3:15, 17]] . (b) from the first, from the beginning: [[luke 1 3|Luk.1:3]], [[acts 26 5|Act.26:5]]; whence (with) anew, again: [[john 3 3|Jhn.3:3]], 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., [[galatians 4 9|Gal.4:9]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀνωτερικός, -ή όν (ἀνώτερος) upper: [[acts 19 1|Act.19:1.]]† (AS)

ἀνώτερος, α, -ον [in LXX: [[nehemiah 3 25|Neh.3:25]] (עֶלְיוֹן), [[ezekiel 41 7|Eze.41:7]] (מַעַל), Tob.8:3 * ;] only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος), (a) of motion, higher: [[luke 14 10|Luk.14:10;]] (b) of rest, above, before: [[hebrews 10 8|Heb.10:8.]]† (AS)

ἀν-ωφελής, -ές (ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: [[isaiah 44 10|Isa.44:10]] (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) [[jeremiah 2 8|Jer.2:8]] (יָעַל לֹא), [[proverbs 28 3|Pro.28:3]], Wis.1:11 * ;] unprofitable: [[titus 3 9|Tit.3:9;]] neut. as subst., unprofitableness: [[hebrews 7 18|Heb.7:18.]]† (AS)
αξίνη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;] an axe: [[matthew 3 10|Mat.3:10]], [[luke 3 9|Luk.3:9]].† (AS)

ἄξιος, -α, -ον (ἄγω, in sense, to weigh), [in LXX for בֵּן ([[deuteronomy 25 2|Deu.25:2]]), מָלֵא, שָׁוָה; frequently in Wis, 2Mac ;] 1. Part One (a) of weight, worth (often with genitive, cf. Pr 315, 811), before πρός: [[romans 8 18|Rom.8:18]] (see Field, Notes, 157); (b) befitting, meet: with genitive, [[matthew 3 8|Mat.3:8]], [[luke 3 8|Luk.3:8 23:41]], [[acts 26 20|Act.26:20]], [[1-corinthians 16 4|1Co.16:4]] (see M, Pr., 216); absol., [[2-thessalonians 1 3|2Th.1:3;]] (with) of persons, worthy; 2. Part Two α in good sense: with genitive of thing(s), [[matthew 10 10|Mat.10:10]], [[luke 7 4|Luk.7:4 10:7]], [[acts 13 46|Act.13:46]], [[1-timothy 1 15|1Ti.1:15 4:9 5:18 6:1]]; with aor. inf. (see M, Pr., 203): [[luke 15 19|Luk.15:19, 21]], Act_13:25, [[revelation 4 11|Rev.4:11 5:2, 4 5:9, 12]]; before ἵνα: [[john 1 27|Jhn.1:27;]] ἅς, [[luke 7 4|Luk.7:4;]] absol., but of what understood: [[matthew 10 11|Mat.10:11, 13 22:8]], [[revelation 3 4|Rev.3:4]]; with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 10 37|Mat.10:37-38]], [[hebrews 11 38|Heb.11:38]]; β in bad sense; with genitive of thing(s), [[luke 12 48|Luk.12:48 23:15]], [[acts 23 29|Act.23:29 25:11, 25 26:31]], [[romans 1 32|Rom.1:32]]; absol., [[revelation 16 6|Rev.16:6]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀξιόω, -ῶ (ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in Wis.1:1-16, 2 Mac ;] (a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), [[luke 7 7|Luk.7:7;]] id. and genitive of thing(s), [[2-thessalonians 1 11|2Th.1:11;]] pass. with genitive of thing(s), [[1-timothy 5 17|1Ti.5:17]], [[hebrews 3 3|Heb.3:3 10:29]] (b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), [[acts 15 38|Act.15:38 28:22]].† (AS)

ἀξίως, adv. [in LXX: Wis.7:15 16:1, Sir.14:11 * ;] worthily: [[romans 16 2|Rom.16:2]], [[ephesians 4 1|Eph.4:1]], [[philippians 1 27|Php.1:27]]; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, [[colossians 1 10|Col.1:10;]] τ. θεοῦ [[1-thessalonians 2 12|1Th.2:12]], 3Jn.6.† (AS)

ἀόρατος, -ον (ὁράω), [in LXX: [[genesis 1 2|Gen.1:2]] (תֹּהוּ), [[isaiah 45 3|Isa.45:3]] (מִסְתָּר), 2Ma.9:5 * ;] unseen, invisible: [[romans 1 20|Rom.1:20]], [[colossians 1 15|Col.1:15-16]], [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]], [[hebrews 11 27|Heb.11:27]].† (AS)

ἀπ-αγγέλλω [in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi. ;] of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 4 23|Act.4:23]], al.; with dative of person(s), [[matthew 2 8|Mat.2:8]], al.; before ὃτι, [[luke 18 37|Luk.18:37;]] πῶς, [[luke 8 36|Luk.8:36;]] περί, [[luke 7 18|Luk.7:18 13:1]], [[acts 28 21|Act.28:21]], [[1-thessalonians 1 9|1Th.1:9]]; λέγων, [[acts 22 26|Act.22:26;]] with accusative and inf., [[acts 12 14|Act.12:14;]] before εἰς, [[mark 5 14|Mrk.5:14]], [[luke 8 34|Luk.8:34]] (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25) (AS)
ἀπ-άγχω (ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 17 23|2Ki.17:23]] (חָנַק), Tob.3:10 * ;] to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): [[matthew 27 5|Mat.27:5.]]† (AS)

ἀπ-άγω [in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;] to lead away: [[luke 13 15|Luk.13:15]], [[acts 23 17|Act.23:17 24:7]] (R, mg.), [[1-corinthians 12 2|1Co.12:2;]] esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): [[matthew 26 57|Mat.26:57 27:2, 31]], [[mark 14 44|Mrk.14:44, 53 15:16]], [[luke 21 12|Luk.21:12 22:66 23:26]], [[acts 12 19|Act.12:19]]; of the direction of a way: [[matthew 7 13|Mat.7:13-14]] (cf. συν-απ-άγω).† (AS)
ἀ-παίδευτος, -ον (παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;] uninstructed, ignorant: [[2-timothy 2 23|2Ti.2:23.]]† (AS)
ἀπ-αίρω [in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;] to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: [[matthew 9 15|Mat.9:15]], [[mark 2 20|Mrk.2:20]], [[luke 5 35|Luk.5:35]].† (AS)
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 15 2|Deu.15:2-3]], al. (נָגַשׂ), Sir.20:15, Wis.15:8, al. ;] to ask back, demand back: [[luke 6 30|Luk.6:30 12:20]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ 1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61). 2. In late Gk. (a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5); (b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): [[ephesians 4 19|Eph.4:19.]]† (AS)

ἀπ-αλλάσσω [in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;] to remove, release: [[hebrews 2 15|Heb.2:15;]] pass., to depart: [[acts 19 12|Act.19:12;]] in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58]] (Cremer, 90, 632).† (AS)
ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ [in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;] to alienate, estrange; pass.: [[ephesians 2 12|Eph.2:12 4:18]], [[colossians 1 21|Col.1:21]] (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).† (AS)
ἀπαλός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for רַךְ ;] tender: [[matthew 24 32|Mat.24:32]], [[mark 13 28|Mrk.13:28]].† (AS)

ἀπαντάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for פָּגַע ;] 1. to go to meet. 2. to meet; with dative: [[mark 14 13|Mrk.14:13]], [[luke 17 12|Luk.17:12]] (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).† (AS)

ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: [[matthew 25 6|Mat.25:6 27:32]] (WH, txt., omits), [[acts 28 15|Act.28:15]], [[1-thessalonians 4 17|1Th.4:17]] (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).† (AS)

ἅπαξ adv., [in LXX for אֶחָד, פַּעַם ;] (a) once: [[2-corinthians 11 25|2Co.11:25]], Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., [[hebrews 12 26|Heb.12:26-27;]] ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, [[hebrews 9 7|Heb.9:7;]] καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: [[philippians 4 16|Php.4:16]], [[1-thessalonians 2 18|1Th.2:18]]; (b) once for all: [[hebrews 6 4|Heb.6:4 9:28 10:2]], [[1-peter 3 18|1Pe.3:18]], Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον (παραβαίνω), inviolable, and so unchangeable: [[hebrews 7 24|Heb.7:24]] (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀ-παρα-σκεύαστος, -ον (παρασκευάζω) unprepared: [[2-corinthians 9 4|2Co.9:4.]]† (AS)

ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon., [in LXX: [[isaiah 31 7|Isa.31:7]] (מָאַס) * ;] to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), [[matthew 16 24|Mat.16:24]], [[mark 8 34|Mrk.8:34]] (MM, VGT, see word), [[luke 9 23|Luk.9:23]] (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, [[matthew 26 34|Mat.26:34-35, 75]], [[mark 14 30|Mrk.14:30-31, 72]], [[luke 22 34|Luk.22:34, 61]]; pass., [[luke 12 9|Luk.12:9]] (Cremer, 111).† (AS)

ἀπάρτι (WH, ἀπ᾽ ἄρτι; cl., ἀπαρτί, ν. MM, VGT, see word); adv., [not in LXX, where עַתָּה is rendered by ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ;] from now, henceforth: [[john 13 19|Jhn.13:19 14:7]], [[revelation 14 13|Rev.14:13]].† (AS)
ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀπαρτίζω, to finish), completion: [[luke 14 28|Luk.14:28]] (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;] 1. the beginning of a sacrifice. 2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. [[numbers 15 20|Num.15:20]]), [[romans 11 16|Rom.11:16]]. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: [[romans 8 23|Rom.8:23;]] of Christians: [[romans 16 5|Rom.16:5]], 1, [[1-corinthians 16 15|1Co.16:15]], [[2-thessalonians 2 13|2Th.2:13]] (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), [[james 1 18|Jas.1:18]], [[revelation 14 4|Rev.14:4]]; of Christ: [[1-corinthians 15 20|1Co.15:20 15:23]] (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἅπας, -ασα, -αν (strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-), all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as [[luke 3 21|Luk.3:21;]] or after, as [[mark 16 15|Mrk.16:15]]]; absol., in masc., as [[luke 5 26|Luk.5:26;]] in neut., as [[acts 2 44|Act.2:44;]] ἅ. οὗτοι, [[acts 2 7|Act.2:7]] (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, [[galatians 3 28|Gal.3:28]] (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

ἀπατάω, -ῶ (ἀπάτη), [in LXX for פָּתָה, נָשָׁא hi., etc. ;] to deceive: with accusative, [[james 1 26|Jas.1:26;]] with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), [[ephesians 5 6|Eph.5:6;]] pass., [[1-timothy 2 14|1Ti.2:14]] (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).† (AS)

ἀπάτη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 9 6|Ecc.9:6]] א (no Heb. equiv.), Jdth.9:3, 10 9:13 16:8, 4Ma.18:8 * ;] deceit, deceitfulness: [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8;]] τοῦ πλούτου, [[matthew 13 22|Mat.13:22]], [[mark 4 19|Mrk.4:19]] (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, [[2-thessalonians 2 10|2Th.2:10;]] τῆς ἁμαρτίας, [[hebrews 3 13|Heb.3:13;]] αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., [[ephesians 4 22|Eph.4:22.]] pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): [[2-peter 2 13|2Pe.2:13]] (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).† (AS)
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ (ἀ- neg., πατήρ) 1. fatherless. 2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: [[hebrews 7 3|Heb.7:3.]]† (AS)
ἀπ-αύγασμα, -τος, τό (αὐγή, brightness, whence ἀπαυγάζω, to radiate or reflect) [in LXX: Wis.7:26 * ;] of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence: [[hebrews 1 3|Heb.1:3.]]† (AS)
ἀπ-εῖδον (WH, ἀφ-, ν. Bl., § 4, 3), 2 aor. without present in use (cf. εἶδον), serving as aor. to ἀφοράω, q.v (AS)

ἀπείθεια (WH, -θία, exc. [[hebrews 11 1|Heb.11:1-40.]] with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), [in LXX 4Ma.8:9 4Mac 8:18 4Mac 12:4 * ;] disobedience (MM, VGT, see word): [[romans 11 30|Rom.11:30, 32]], [[hebrews 4 6|Heb.4:6, 11]]; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, Pr., 73 f.), [[ephesians 2 2|Eph.2:2 5:6]], [[colossians 3 6|Col.3:6]] (T, WH R, mg., omit).† (AS)

ἀπειθέω, -ῶ (ἀπειθής), [in LXX for מָרָה, סָרַר, etc. ;] as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., [[acts 14 2|Act.14:2 19:9]], [[romans 10 21|Rom.10:21 11:31 15:31]], [[hebrews 3 18|Heb.3:18 11:31]], [[1-peter 3 20|1Pe.3:20]]; with dative, [[john 3 36|Jhn.3:36]], [[romans 2 8|Rom.2:8 11:30]], [[1-peter 2 8|1Pe.2:8 3:1 4:17]] (Cremer, 475).† (AS)

ἀπειθής, -ές (πείθομαι), [in LXX for מַרְאָה, מְרִיא, סָרַר ;] disobedient: absol., [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17]], [[titus 1 16|Tit.1:16 3:3]]; with dative, [[acts 26 19|Act.26:19]], [[romans 1 30|Rom.1:30]], [[2-timothy 3 2|2Ti.3:2]].† (AS)

ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή) [in LXX: [[nahum 1 4|Nam.1:4]] (גָּעַר), [[isaiah 66 14|Isa.66:14]] (זָעַם), Sir.19:17, al. ;] to threaten: [[1-peter 2 23|1Pe.2:23;]] mid., [[acts 4 17|Act.4:17]] (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).† (AS)
ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ [in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;] threatening, threat: [[acts 4 29|Act.4:29 9:1]], [[ephesians 6 9|Eph.6:9]].† (AS)

ἄπ-ειμι (εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;] to be absent: [[1-corinthians 5 3|1Co.5:3]], [[2-corinthians 10 1|2Co.10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10]] [[philippians 1 27|Php.1:27]], [[colossians 2 5|Col.2:5]].† (AS)
ἄπ-ειμι (εἶμι, ibo) to depart: [[acts 17 10|Act.17:10.]]† (AS)

ἀπ-εῖπον, 2 aor. without present in use [in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;] 1. to tell out. 2. to forbid ([[1-kings 11 2|3Ki.11:2]]). 3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), [[2-corinthians 4 2|2Co.4:2.]]† (AS)
απείραστος, -ον (πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω), untempted, untried, without experience: [[james 1 13|Jas.1:13]] (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἄπειρος, -ον (ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), [in LXX: [[numbers 14 23|Num.14:23]], [[zechariah 11 15|Zec.11:15]] (אֱוִלִי) [[jeremiah 2 6|Jer.2:6]] (עֲרָבָה) * ;] without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), [[hebrews 5 13|Heb.5:13]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι depon., to await or expect eagerly (Lft., Notes, 149; MM, VGT, see word): absol., [[1-peter 3 20|1Pe.3:20;]] C. accusative of thing(s), [[romans 8 19|Rom.8:19, 23 8:25]], [[1-corinthians 1 7|1Co.1:7]], [[galatians 5 5|Gal.5:5]]; with accusative of person(s), [[philippians 3 20|Php.3:20]], [[hebrews 9 28|Heb.9:28]].† (AS)

ἀπ-εκ-δύω to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: [[colossians 3 9|Col.3:9;]] to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), [[colossians 2 15|Col.2:15.]]† (AS)
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπεκδύω) a putting or stripping off: [[colossians 2 11|Col.2:11]] (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
ἀπ-ελαύνω [in LXX for נָצַל, שָׁלַח ;] to drive away: [[acts 18 16|Act.18:16]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute), refutation, disrepute: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., [[acts 19 27|Act.19:27]] (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπ-ελεύθερος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ a freedman: τ. κυρίου (MM, see word), [[1-corinthians 7 22|1Co.7:22.]]† (AS)
Ἀπελλῆς, -οῦ, accusative -ῆν (MM, see word), ὁ Apelles: [[romans 16 10|Rom.16:10.]]† (AS)

ἀπ-ελπίζω [in LXX: [[isaiah 29 19|Isa.29:19]] (אֶבְיוֹן), Jdth.9:11, [[esther 4 17|Est.4:17]], Sir.22:21 27:21, 2Ma.9:18 * ;] 1. to give up in despair, despair of (Polyb., Diod., LXX). 2. to hope to receive from or in return (Field, Notes, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., Lex., see word): with accusative (M; Pr., 65; MM, see word), [[luke 6 35|Luk.6:35.]]† (AS)

ἀπ-έναντι adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX); 1. over against (MM, see word): [[matthew 27 61|Mat.27:61]], [[mark 12 41|Mrk.12:41]], WH, mg. 2. before, in the presence of: [[matthew 27 24|Mat.27:24]] (WH, mg.), [[acts 3 16|Act.3:16]], [[romans 3 18|Rom.3:18]]. 3. against: [[acts 17 7|Act.17:7.]]† (AS)
ἀπέραντος, -ον (περαίνω, to complete, finish) [in LXX: [[job 36 26|Job.36:26]] (חֵקֶר אַיִן) 3Mac.20 * ;] endless, interminable: [[1-timothy 1 4|1Ti.1:4.]]† (AS)
ἀπεριστπάστως adv. (περισπάω the adj. occurs in Wis.16:11 Sir.41:1); without distraction: [[1-corinthians 7 35|1Co.7:35.]]† (AS)

ἀ-περί-τμητος, -ον (περιτέμνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָרֵל ;] uncir­cumcised; metaphorically (τ.) καρδίαις (cf. [[jeremiah 9 26|Jer.9:26]], al.): [[acts 7 51|Act.7:51]] (ἄσημος, found in π., appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians: see Deiss., BS, 153; cf. also Cremer, 885; MM, see word)† (AS)

ἀπέρχομαι, [in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;] 1. to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word); (a) absol.: [[matthew 13 25|Mat.13:25]], al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, Words, 21), [[matthew 13 28|Mat.13:28]], al.; (b) with mention of place or person: εἰς, [[matthew 14 15|Mat.14:15;]] ἐπί, [[luke 24 24|Luk.24:24;]] πρός, [[revelation 10 9|Rev.10:9;]] ἀπό, [[luke 1 38|Luk.1:38;]] ἐξω, [[acts 4 15|Act.4:15;]] ἐκεῖ, [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22.]] 2. As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), to go after, follow: [[mark 1 20|Mrk.1:20]], [[john 12 19|Jhn.12:19]]; metaphorically, [[mark 1 42|Mrk.1:42]], [[revelation 21 1|Rev.21:1]]. (AS)

to receive (in full); to be distant; (middle) to abstain, avoid trans. to have in full what is due or is sought, [[matthew 6 2|Mt. 6:2, 5, 16]]; [[luke 6 24|Lk. 6:24]]; [[philippians 4 18|Phil. 4:18;]] to have altogether, Phlm. 15; hence, it is enough, [[mark 14 41|Mk. 14:41]]; intransitive to be distant, [[luke 7 6|Lk. 7:6]]; to be estranged, [[matthew 15 8|Mt. 15:8]]; [[mark 7 6|Mk. 7:6]], middle to abstain from, [[acts 14 20|Acts 14:20]]
refrain, receive/be far, keep away from

ἀπ-έχω [in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;] 1. trans., (a) to hold back, keep off; (b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, [[matthew 6 2|Mat.6:2, 5 6:16]], [[luke 6 24|Luk.6:24]], [[philippians 4 18|Php.4:18]], Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: [[mark 14 41|Mrk.14:41.]] 2. Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., [[luke 15 20|Luk.15:20;]] before ἀπό, [[matthew 14 24|Mat.14:24 15:8]], [[mark 7 6|Mrk.7:6]], [[luke 7 6|Luk.7:6 15:20 24:13]]. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, [[acts 15 29|Act.15:29]], [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3]], [[1-peter 2 11|1Pe.2:11]]; before ἀπό, [[acts 15 20|Act.15:20]], [[1-thessalonians 4 3|1Th.4:3 5:22]].† (AS)

ἀπιστέω, -ῶ (ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13, Sir.1:27, 2Ma.8:13 * ;] 1. to disbelieve, be faithless: [[mark 16 11|Mrk.16:11, 16]], [[luke 24 11|Luk.24:11, 41]], [[acts 28 24|Act.28:24]], [[1-peter 2 7|1Pe.2:7]]; so prob. also [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3]], [[2-timothy 2 13|2Ti.2:13]] (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word). 2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).† (AS)

ἀπιστία, -ας, ἡ (ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.14:25, 4Ma.12:4 * ;] want of faith, unbelief: [[matthew 13 58|Mat.13:58]], [[mark 6 6|Mrk.6:6 9:24 16:14]], [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3]] (but see: ἀπιστέω) [[romans 4 20|Rom.4:20 11:20, 23]], [[1-timothy 1 13|1Ti.1:13]], [[hebrews 3 12|Heb.3:12, 19]] (DCG, ii, 775a; Cremer, 492).† (AS)

ἄ-πιστος, -ον (ἀ- neg., πιστός) [in LXX: [[proverbs 17 6|Pro.17:6 28:25]], [[isaiah 17 10|Isa.17:10]] * ;] (a) of things, incredible: [[acts 26 8|Act.26:8;]] (b) of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving: [[matthew 17 17|Mat.17:17]], [[mark 9 19|Mrk.9:19]], [[luke 9 41|Luk.9:41 12:46]], [[john 20 27|Jhn.20:27]], [[titus 1 15|Tit.1:15]], [[revelation 21 8|Rev.21:8]]; specif., of unbelievers as opposite to Christians: [[1-corinthians 6 6|1Co.6:6 7:12-15 10:27 14:22-24]], [[2-corinthians 4 4|2Co.4:4 6:14-15]], [[1-timothy 5 8|1Ti.5:8]] (cf. Lft., Notes, 265; Cremer, 491).† (AS)

ἀπλότης, -ητος, ή (ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: [[2-kings 15 11|4Ki.15:11]] (תֹּם), [[1-chronicles 29 17|1Ch.29:17]] (לֵבָב יֹשֶׁר, ἁ. τῆς καρδίας, cf. [[colossians 3 22|Col.3:22]], where see Lft.), Wis.1:1, al. ;] simplicity, sincerity: [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8]], [[2-corinthians 11 3|2Co.11:3]], [[ephesians 6 5|Eph.6:5]], [[colossians 3 22|Col.3:22]]; as manifested in generous, unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness: [[2-corinthians 8 2|2Co.8:2 9:11 9:13]] (see ICC, [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8;]] Hort, [[james 1 5|Jas.1:5]], and see: ἁπλῶς).† (AS)

ἁπλοῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν (contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), [in LXX: [[proverbs 11 25|Pro.11:25]] * ;] simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, [[matthew 6 22|Mat.6:22]], [[luke 11 34|Luk.11:34]]. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).† ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639) (AS)

ἁπλῶς adv. (ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: [[proverbs 10 9|Pro.10:9]] (תֹּם), Wis.16:27, 2Ma.6:6 * ;] simply, sincerely, graciously: [[james 1 5|Jas.1:5.]] ("Later writers comprehend under the one word the whole magnanimous and honour­able type of character in which ... singleness of mind is the central feature "-Hort, Ja., l.with)† (AS)

ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146), prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), [in LXX for לְ ,בְּ ,מִן ;] from (i.e. from the exterior). 1. Of separation and cessation; (1) of motion from a place: [[matthew 5 29|Mat.5:29, 30 7:23]], [[luke 5 2|Luk.5:2 22:41]], al.; (2) in partitive sense (M, Pr., 72, 102, 245; MM, see word; Bl., §40, 2), [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16 27:21]], [[john 21 10|Jhn.21:10]], [[acts 5 2|Act.5:2]], al.; also after verbs of eating, etc.; (3) of alienation (cl. genitive of separation), after such verbs as λούω (Deiss., BS, 227), λύω, σώζω, παύω, etc.; ἀνάθεμα ἀ., [[romans 9 3|Rom.9:3;]] ἀποθνήσκειν ἀ., [[colossians 2 20|Col.2:20;]] σαλευθῆναι, [[2-thessalonians 2 2|2Th.2:2]], καθαρός, -ίζειν, ἀ. (Deiss., BS, 196, 216), [[acts 20 26|Act.20:26]], [[2-corinthians 7 1|2Co.7:1]], [[hebrews 9 14|Heb.9:14]]; (4) of position, [[matthew 23 34|Mat.23:34 24:31]], al.; after μακράν, [[matthew 8 30|Mat.8:30;]] transposed before measures of distance, [[john 10 18|Jhn.10:18 21:8]], [[revelation 14 20|Rev.14:20]] (Abbott, JG, 227); (5) of time, ἀπὸ τ. ὥρας, ἡμέρας, etc., [[matthew 9 22|Mat.9:22]], [[john 19 27|Jhn.19:27]], [[acts 20 18|Act.20:18]], [[philippians 1 5|Php.1:5]], al.; ἀπ᾽ αἰῶνος, [[luke 1 70|Luk.1:70]], al.; ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς, etc., [[matthew 19 4|Mat.19:4]], [[romans 1 20|Rom.1:20]]; ἀπὸ βρέφους, [[2-timothy 3 15|2Ti.3:15;]] ἀφ᾽ ἧς, since, [[luke 7 45|Luk.7:45]], al.; ἀπὸ τ. νῦν, [[luke 1 48|Luk.1:48]], al.; ἀπὸ τότε, [[matthew 4 17|Mat.4:17]], al.; ἀπὸ πέρυσι, a year ago, [[2-corinthians 8 10|2Co.8:10 9:2]]; ἀπὸ πρωΐ, [[acts 28 23|Act.28:23;]] (6) of order or rank, ἀπὸ διετοῦς, [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16;]] ἀπὸ Ἀβραάμ, [[matthew 1 17|Mat.1:17;]] ἐβδομος ἀπὸ Ἀδάμ, Ju 14; ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου, [[acts 8 10|Act.8:10]], [[hebrews 8 11|Heb.8:11]]; ἄρχεσθαι ἀπό, [[matthew 20 8|Mat.20:8]], [[john 8 9|Jhn.8:9]], [[acts 8 35|Act.8:35]], al. 2. Of origin; (1) of birth, extraction, and hence, in late writers, (a) of local extraction (cl. ἐξ; Abbott, JG, 227ff.), [[matthew 21 11|Mat.21:11]], [[mark 15 43|Mrk.15:43]], [[john 1 45|Jhn.1:45]], [[acts 10 38|Act.10:38]], al.; οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας (WM, §66, 6; M, Pr., 237; Westc, Rendall, in l.), [[hebrews 13 24|Heb.13:24;]] (b) of membership in a community or society (BL, §40, 2), [[acts 12 1|Act.12:1]], al.; (with) of material (= cl. genitive; Bl. l.with; M, Pr., 102), [[matthew 3 4|Mat.3:4 27:21]]; (d) after verbs of asking, seeking, etc., [[luke 11 50|Luk.11:50, 51]] [[1-thessalonians 2 6|1Th.2:6]] (Milligan, in l.); (2) of the cause, instrument, means or occasion (frequently = ὑπό, παρά, and after verbs of learning, hearing, knowing, etc.; Bl., §40, 3), [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16 11:29]], [[luke 22 45|Luk.22:45]], [[acts 2 22|Act.2:22 4:36 9:13 12:14]], [[1-corinthians 11 23|1Co.11:23]], [[galatians 3 2|Gal.3:2]], al.; ἀπὸ τ. ὄχλου, [[luke 19 3|Luk.19:3]] (cf. [[john 21 6|Jhn.21:6]], [[acts 22 11|Act.22:11]]); ἀπὸ τ. φόβου, [[matthew 14 26|Mat.14:26]], al. (cf. [[matthew 10 26|Mat.10:26 13:44]]). 3. Noteworthy Hellenistic phrases: φοβεῖσθαι ἀπό (M, Pr., 102, 107); προσέχειν ἀπό (M, Pr., 11. with; Milligan, NTD, 50); ἀπὸ νότου (Heb. מִגֶּנֶב), [[revelation 21 13|Rev.21:13;]] ἀπὸ προσώπου (מִפְּנֵי), [[2-thessalonians 1 9|2Th.1:9]] (Bl., §40, 9); ἀπὸ τ. καρδιῶν (בְּלֵב), [[matthew 18 35|Mat.18:35;]] ἀπὸ ὁ ὤν (WM, §10, 2; M, Pr., 9), [[revelation 1 4|Rev.1:4.]] 4. In composition, ἀπό denotes separation, departure, origin, etc. (ἀπολύω, ἀπέρχομαι, ἀπογράφω); it also has a perfective force (M, Pr., 112, 247), as in ἀφικνεῖσθαι, which see (AS)

ἀπο-βαίνω [in LXX for הָיָה, etc. ;] to step off, disembark: [[luke 5 2|Luk.5:2]], [[john 21 9|Jhn.21:9]]; metaphorically, of events, to issue, turn out (Field, Notes, 74): [[luke 21 13|Luk.21:13]], [[philippians 1 19|Php.1:19]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀπο-βάλλω [in LXX: [[isaiah 1 30|Isa.1:30]] (נָבֵל) and elsew. without Heb. equiv. ;] to throw off: [[mark 10 50|Mrk.10:50;]] metaphorically, to lose, let go (Field, Notes, 231 f.; MM, see word): [[hebrews 10 35|Heb.10:35.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-βλέπω [in LXX for פָּנָה, etc. ;] to look away from all else at one object; hence, to look steadfastly: [[hebrews 11 26|Heb.11:26]] (cf. ἀφοράω).† (AS)
ἀπό-βλητος, -ον (ἀποβάλλω), [in Aq.: [[leviticus 7 18|Lev.7:18]], al.; Sm.: [[hosea 9 3|Hos.9:3]] (טָמֵא) ;] to be thrown away, rejected: [[1-timothy 4 4|1Ti.4:4]] (Hom., Plut.).† (AS)
ἀπο-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀποβάλλω); 1. a throwing away, rejection: opposite to πρόσλημψις, [[romans 11 15|Rom.11:15.]] 2. a losing, loss: [[acts 27 22|Act.27:22.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-γίνομαι (cl. -γίγν-) [in LXX: Da TH [[daniel 2 1|Dan.2:1]] * ;] 1. to be away, removed from. 2. to depart life, to die (MM, see word): τ. ἀμαρτίαις, i.e. with ref. to sins, [[1-peter 2 24|1Pe.2:24]] (Cremer, 149, 668).† (AS)

ἀπο-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπογράφω) [in LXX: [[daniel 10 21|Dan.10:21]] (כָּתָב), I [[esther 8 30|Est.8:30]], AB, 2Ma.2:1, 3Ma.2:32 3Mac 4:15 3Mac 4:17 3Mac 7:22 * ;] 1. a written copy. 2. As law term, a deposition (Demos.). 3. In late writers, a register, enrolment, census (MM, see word; Deiss., LAE, 160, 268 f.): [[luke 2 2|Luk.2:2]], [[acts 5 37|Act.5:37]].† (AS)

ἀπο-γράφω [in LXX: [[judges 8 14|Jdg.8:14]], [[proverbs 22 20|Pro.22:20]] (כָּתַב), I [[esther 8 30|Est.8:30]], 3Ma.2:29 3Mac 4:14 3Mac 6:34 3Mac 6:38 * ;] 1. to write out, copy. 2. to enrol; mid., to enrol oneself: [[luke 2 1|Luk.2:1]] (M, Pr., 162; but. see ICC, in l), [[luke 2 3|Luk.2:3]], 5; pass., [[hebrews 12 23|Heb.12:23]] (see reff, see word ἀπογραφή ).† (AS)

ἀπο-δείκνυμι [in LXX: [[esther 2 9|Est.2:9]] (רָאָה), al. ;] 1. to bring out, show forth, exhibit (Lft., Notes, 200; ICC, in l): [[1-corinthians 4 9|1Co.4:9.]] 2. to declare, show: [[acts 2 22|Act.2:22]] 3. to prove: [[acts 25 7|Act.25:7.]] 4. As frequently in late Gk., to proclaim to an office: before ὅτι, [[2-thessalonians 2 4|2Th.2:4]] (Milligan, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes. 113.)† (AS)

ἀπό-δειξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποδείκνυμι) [in LXX: 3Ma.4:20, 4Ma.3:19 4Mac 13:10 * ;] 1. a showing off. 2. As used by Gk. philosophers, demonstration, certain proof: [[1-corinthians 2 4|1Co.2:4]] (see ICC, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes, 173).† (AS)

ἀπο-δεκατοω, [in LXX for עָשַׂר in both senses foll., e.g. (1) [[genesis 28 22|Gen.28:22]] (2) [[1-samuel 8 15|1Ki.8:15]] ;] 1. with accusative of thing(s), to tithe, pay a tenth of: [[matthew 23 23|Mat.23:23]], [[luke 11 42|Luk.11:42]]. 2. C. accusative of person(s), to exact tithes from: [[hebrews 7 5|Heb.7:5.]] 3. to decimate (Socr., HE, 573 A; see Kennedy, Sources, 117).† (AS)
ἀπό-δεκτος, -ον (άποδέχομαι), acceptable: [[1-timothy 2 3|1Ti.2:3 5:4]].† (AS)

ἀπο-δέχομαι [in LXX: Tob.7:17, Jdth.13:13; Jdt.13.1, 4Mac.10:1-21 * ;] to accept gladly, welcome, receive: [[luke 8 40|Luk.8:40 9:11]], [[acts 18 27|Act.18:27 21:17 28:30]]; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 2 41|Act.2:41 24:3]] (MM, see word; Cremer, 688).† (AS)

ἀπο-δημέω, -ῶ (ἀπόδημος), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 19 3|Eze.19:3]] A * ;] to be or go abroad (M, Pr., 130, 2): [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33 25:14-15]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1]], [[luke 15 13|Luk.15:13 20:9]].† (AS)
ἀπό-δημος, -ον gone abroad (RV, sojourning in another country): [[mark 13 34|Mrk.13:34.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-δίδωμι [in LXX for מָכַר, שׁוּב hi., נָתַן, שָׁלֵם pi., etc. ;] to give up or back, restore, return: [[matthew 27 58|Mat.27:58]], [[luke 4 20|Luk.4:20 9:42 19:8]]; esp. of wages, debts, oaths, etc. (MM, see word), to render what is due, to pay (Deiss., LAE, 334 f.): absol., [[matthew 18 25|Mat.18:25, 28]], [[luke 7 42|Luk.7:42]]. with accusative, [[matthew 5 26|Mat.5:26 18:29-30, 34 20:8 21:41 22:21]], [[mark 12 17|Mrk.12:17]], [[luke 10 35|Luk.10:35 12:59 20:25]], [[romans 13 7|Rom.13:7]], [[hebrews 12 11|Heb.12:11]], [[revelation 22 2|Rev.22:2]]; ὅρκους, [[matthew 5 33|Mat.5:33]] (cf. [[numbers 30 3|Num.30:3]], [[deuteronomy 23 21|Deu.23:21]] al.); of conjugal duty, τ. ὀφειλήν, [[1-corinthians 7 3|1Co.7:3;]] ἀμοιβάς, [[1-timothy 5 4|1Ti.5:4;]] μαρτύριον, to give (as in duty bound) testimony, [[acts 4 33|Act.4:33;]] λόγον, to render account, [[matthew 12 36|Mat.12:36]], [[luke 16 2|Luk.16:2]], [[acts 19 40|Act.19:40]], [[hebrews 13 17|Heb.13:17]], [[1-peter 4 5|1Pe.4:5]]; hence of requital, recompense, both in good and bad sense, [[matthew 6 4|Mat.6:4, 6 6:18 16:27]], [[romans 2 6|Rom.2:6]], [[2-timothy 4 8|2Ti.4:8 4:14]] [[revelation 18 6|Rev.18:6 22:12]]; κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ, [[romans 12 17|Rom.12:17]], [[1-thessalonians 5 15|1Th.5:15]], [[1-peter 3 9|1Pe.3:9]]. Mid., to give up of one's own, hence to sell (fr. Hdt. on): with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 5 8|Act.5:8]], [[hebrews 12 16|Heb.12:16]]; with accusative of person(s), [[acts 7 9|Act.7:9]] (cf. ἀνταποδίδωμι) .† (AS)
ἀπο-δι-ορίζω (διορίζω, ἅρος, a limit), to mark off, hence metaphorically to make separations: Ju 19 (Cremer, 806).† (AS)

ἀπο-δοκιμάζω [in LXX: [[psalms 118 22|Psa.118:22]], al. (מָאַס) ;] to reject: [[matthew 21 42|Mat.21:42]] (LXX), [[mark 8 31|Mrk.8:31 12:10]]" (LXX) [[luke 9 22|Luk.9:22 17:25 20:17]]" (LXX), [[hebrews 12 17|Heb.12:17]], [[1-peter 2 4|1Pe.2:4 2:7]]" (LXX) (Cremer, 701; MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπο-δοχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀποδέχομαι), acceptance, approbation (Field, Notes, 203): [[1-timothy 1 15|1Ti.1:15 4:9]] (Cremer, 686; MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀπό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀποτίθημι), a putting away: [[1-peter 3 21|1Pe.3:21]], [[2-peter 1 14|2Pe.1:14]].† (AS)
ἀπο-θήκη, -ης, ἡ (ἀποτίθημι), [in LXX for אוֹצָר, טֶנֶא, etc. ;] a storehouse, granary: [[matthew 3 12|Mat.3:12 6:26 13:30]], [[luke 3 17|Luk.3:17 12:18, 24]].† (AS)
ἀπο-θησαυρίζω [in LXX: Sir.3:4 * ;] to treasure up, store away: [[1-timothy 6 19|1Ti.6:19.]]† (AS)
ἀπο-θλίβω [in LXX for לָחַץ, [[numbers 22 25|Num.22:25]] * ;] to press hard: [[luke 8 45|Luk.8:45.]]† (AS)

ἀπο-θνῄσκω, [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] to die: of natural death, [[mark 5 35|Mrk.5:35]], al.; of violent death (pass. of ἀποκτείνω), esp. of Christ, [[matthew 26 35|Mat.26:35]], [[john 12 33|Jhn.12:33]], [[hebrews 10 28|Heb.10:28]], al.; of spiritual death, [[john 6 50|Jhn.6:50]], [[romans 8 13|Rom.8:13]], al.; with dative ref., [[romans 6 2|Rom.6:2, 10 14:7, 8]], [[galatians 2 19|Gal.2:19]]; accusative, ὅ, [[romans 6 10|Rom.6:10;]] before ἐν, [[matthew 8 32|Mat.8:32]], [[john 8 21|Jhn.8:21, 24]] [[1-corinthians 15 22|1Co.15:22]], [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37]], [[revelation 14 13|Rev.14:13]]; before ὑπέρ, περί, [[john 11 50|Jhn.11:50, 51 18:14]], [[romans 5 6|Rom.5:6-8 14:15]], [[1-corinthians 15 3|1Co.15:3]], [[2-corinthians 5 15|2Co.5:15]], [[1-thessalonians 5 10|1Th.5:10]], [[1-peter 3 18|1Pe.3:18]]; ἀπό, [[colossians 2 20|Col.2:20;]] ἐκ, [[revelation 8 11|Rev.8:11;]] figuratively, [[1-corinthians 15 31|1Co.15:31]] (cf. συν-αποθνήσκω, and V. Milligan, NTD, 258f.; DCG, i, 791b; Cremer, 286; MM, see word; on the perfective force of this verb, M, Pr., 112, 114; and on the distinction bet. present and aor., ib. 113 f.). (AS)
